work_conn.execute(text("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #af41_34_6"))

SELECT  T1.MONEDA,
        T1.[A\u00d1O],
        T1.TRIM,
        34 AS SECTOR,
        '6' AS C_CAGENTE,
        T1.C_CUENTA,
        'D' AS C_ENTRADA,
        SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SECTOR=34 THEN T1.DATO*-1 ELSE T1.DATO END) AS DATO,
        T1.C_SCN,
        T1.N_SCN,
        'PS' AS FUENTE,
        '0179a' AS PROC
